description: Parks the current work in the collaboration's queue so another session (a teammate, or you on another computer, or you after the usage limit resets) can continue it. Use it when the usage limit or context is nearly used up, or the user says to pass the work on.

needsPerson.description: True when this is a question or decision for a human: no agent is started on it.

resetsAt.description: Optional ISO time when the usage limit is expected back. The background watcher does not start before it.

state.description: What is done, what is next, which files, open questions. No secrets.

title.description: Short name of the work, e.g. Finish auth refactor.

name: meshingly_handoff
